question.question: What is the scientific decision for Hypericum perforatum L. for Preparation specification as Dry extract in EU?

records.notes: EMA European Union herbal monograph specifies a well-established-use dry extract of Hypericum perforatum herba with DER 3-7:1 and extraction solvent methanol 80% V/V.
records.source_title: European Union herbal monograph on Hypericum perforatum L., herba - Revision 1
